import HartshorneLib.Chapter4KaehlerDifferentialSections

/-!
# Local realization by section-ring differentials

A rational differential belonging to the differential lattice at a point is
the image of a Kahler differential on an affine neighborhood. The neighborhood
can be chosen inside any prescribed open containing the point. The proof
localizes affine differentials at the point and then inverts the resulting
denominator on a basic open; smoothness and properness are not needed.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- A regular differential at a point is represented by a section-ring
differential on an affine neighborhood inside any prescribed neighborhood. -/
theorem exists_kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_eq
    {x : X.left} {W : X.left.Opens} (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hη : η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    ∃ (U : X.left.Opens), IsAffineOpen U ∧ U ≤ W ∧ ∃ hxU : x ∈ U,
      letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
      letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
      ∃ ξ : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k],
        (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U ⟨x, hxU⟩ ξ :
          CurveRationalDifferentials X) = η := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVW⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hxW
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField :=
    curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X V
      ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) ⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      X.left.functionField := functionField_isScalarTower X.left V ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  let S := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
  let f := KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule S f :=
    KaehlerDifferential.isLocalizedModule_map k Γ(X.left, V)
      (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) S
  obtain ⟨ηx, hηx⟩ := hη
  obtain ⟨⟨ξ, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S f ηx
  let U := X.left.basicOpen (s : Γ(X.left, V))
  have hUV : U ≤ V := X.left.basicOpen_le (s : Γ(X.left, V))
  have hxU : x ∈ U := (X.left.mem_basicOpen (s : Γ(X.left, V)) x hxV).mpr
    (IsLocalization.map_units (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s)
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra
  let r := X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) := r.hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    exact (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE hUV).op a).symm
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
    curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U
      ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) ⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    exact (X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hUV) (genericPoint X.left)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) ⟨x, hxU⟩) a).symm
  have hu : IsUnit (r.hom s) :=
    X.left.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen (s : Γ(X.left, V))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  let ξU := (↑v⁻¹ : Γ(X.left, U)) •
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) ξ
  refine ⟨U, hV.basicOpen (s : Γ(X.left, V)), hUV.trans hVW, hxU, ξU, ?_⟩
  rw [kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe]
  have hcomp (ζ : Ω[Γ(X.left, V)⁄k]) :
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField
        (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) ζ) =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField ζ := by
    have heq :
        ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField).restrictScalars
          Γ(X.left, V)).comp
            (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U)) =
          KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField := by
      ext a
      simp [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U)
        X.left.functionField]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun heq ζ
  have hcompX :
      ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField).restrictScalars
        Γ(X.left, V)).comp f =
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField := by
    ext a
    simp [f, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X.left, V)
      (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField]
  have hsη : (s : Γ(X.left, V)) • η =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField ξ := by
    rw [← hηx]
    calc
      _ = KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
          X.left.functionField ((s : Γ(X.left, V)) • ηx) :=
        (((KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
          X.left.functionField).restrictScalars Γ(X.left, V)).map_smul s ηx).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
          X.left.functionField) hs |>.trans (LinearMap.congr_fun hcompX ξ)
  change KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField
    ((↑v⁻¹ : Γ(X.left, U)) • _) = η
  rw [map_smul, hcomp, ← hsη]
  change (v : Γ(X.left, U)) = algebraMap Γ(X.left, V) Γ(X.left, U) s at hv
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul Γ(X.left, U) (s : Γ(X.left, V)),
    ← hv, smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul]

end
end Hartshorne
